atoms.title: Audio is primary
atoms.body: Cut candidates from speech boundaries and silence; visuals follow.

atoms.title: Ask→confirm→execute
atoms.body: Never touch the cut until strategy confirmed in plain English.

atoms.title: 30ms audio fades at cuts
atoms.body: Prevents audible pops at segment boundaries.

atoms.title: Never cut inside a word
atoms.body: Snap edges to ASR word boundaries; pad 30–200ms.

atoms.title: Never invent product UI labels
atoms.body: Mirror real app screenshots — #1 launch video cringe source.

atoms.title: Product within 3 seconds
atoms.body: a16z Speedrun research on launch videos.

atoms.title: HyperFrames for agents, Remotion for React
atoms.body: HTML/GSAP agent-friendly; Remotion for complex React systems.

atoms.title: Pick approach by goal
atoms.body: Programmatic / AI gen / avatars / repurpose — different stacks.

atoms.title: 4 parallel critics after render
atoms.body: Design, text, narrative, brand — roast not praise.
